study_type_evidence.quote: 5 mg/kg of GLP-1-PEG-WT-albumin, GLP-1-PEG-HB-albumin or WT-albumin were administered intravenously to NMRI mice
In vitro biological activities of GLP-1, GLP-1-PEG-mal and GLP-1-PEG-WT-albumin conjugates were determined by an agonist-binding assay using TC6 pancreatic tumour cells.
Biolayer interferometry on an Octet Red96 system (PALL/ForteBio) was used to characterize the binding kinetics of the GLP-1-PEG-albumin conjugates.

in_vivo_species.strain_sex_age: NMRI, female, aged 8-10 weeks, weight between 20 and 22 g
in_vivo_species.quote: administered intravenously to NMRI mice (female, aged 8-10 weeks, weight between 20 and 22 g, 10 mice/compound, 5 mice/time point)

in_vitro_detail: Cell-based GLP-1R agonist activity was measured as cAMP generation by homogeneous time resolved fluorescence (HTRF) in beta-TC6 pancreatic tumour cells. Cell-free work: biolayer interferometry (Octet Red96) against biotinylated mouse and human FcRn immobilized on streptavidin biosensors at pH 5.5, and small angle X-ray scattering (SAXS) at beamline I911-SAXS, MAX IV, on rHSA variants and GLP-1 albumin conjugates.

notes: PDF-derived text with a properly fenced abstract; nothing inside the fence was used. Table 2 came out of the PDF with its column labels split across lines ('Cl (mL.kg-1.h-1)' floated above the data rows and the header block 'Compound / Tmax (h) / Cmax (ug/mL) / t1/2 (h) / VZ (mL/kg) / AUC0- (h.ug/mL)' printed below them). Column order was resolved from the caption's definition sequence (Tmax, Cmax, AUC0-inf, t1/2, VZ, Cl) and then verified arithmetically for all three dosed compounds: with a 5 mg/kg dose, Cl = dose/AUC reproduces the printed Cl to within rounding (5000/1481 = 3.4; 5000/276 = 18.1; 5000/494 = 10.1) and VZ = Cl*t1/2/ln2 reproduces the printed VZ (104/105, 223/222, 143/144). The half-life values also match the running text (8.5 h and 9.9 h), so Table 2 is read with confidence. The GLP-1 row of Table 2 is flagged: the METHODS list only three administered compounds (GLP-1-PEG-WT-albumin, GLP-1-PEG-HB-albumin, WT-albumin), and the same paragraph cites a literature value ('Reported GLP-1 half-life in mice is approx. 2 min 58'), so 0.0358 h may be a cited rather than measured value. All Tmax values are 0.5 h, which equals the first post-dose sampling time after an intravenous bolus. No absorption half-life is reported for any compound, consistent with intravenous dosing. Table S1 (a selection of GLP-1 variants with reported half-lives) and all other supplementary material were not available and were not used.
